parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill
The Backlog Is Not the Quarter

mentions.excerpt: Vertiv, a cooling and power supplier, added $3.27 billion of revenue in a quarter and still undershot its own guidance because it could not build fast enough.
Edelbridge rated Vertiv's execution risk at 3.5 on a 5 scale on September 14, the risk being manufacturing added too fast for quality or margin.
Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta and Vertiv report, and the Fed decides the same day.
